passage.label: exalt praise Lord seek forgiveness Indeed ever Accepting repentance

arabicExcerpts.text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا

mainSubject.label: The Prophet commanded to exalt his Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever Accepting of repentance

subordinateSubjects.label: Exalt your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever Accepting of repentance

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Exalt your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Victory met not with triumphalism but with praise and forgiveness-seeking

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the mass-conversion observation (2) before the tasbih-istighfar command opens (3); P2 is the single-verse closing instruction linking divine victory to praise, forgiveness-seeking and the affirmation that Allah accepts repentance.
